purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign022 mechanism without opening a Campaign022 minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Do one-minute bars repeatedly finish nearer their own highs than their own lows, indicating persistent within-bar demand acceptance that may continue from the next open through the third close?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A larger range-normalized excess of close-to-low distance over high-to-close distance means that transactions repeatedly finish near the upper part of their own minute ranges. Persistent within-bar demand acceptance may carry into the next three sessions.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Aggregate own-bar close location over all 240 continuous-session one-minute bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; never select a subwindow or use adjacent-bar, lunch, overnight, or cross-stock transitions.
known_design_risks: arithmetic versus logarithmic distance, ratio-of-sums versus mean per-bar location, bar support, zero-range handling, minimum informative support, containment tolerance, direction, and weighting are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values

the candidate may be statistically redundant with signed path efficiency, terminal close location, body-range efficiency, prior-range breakout pressure, or the low-coverage transaction-VWAP envelope factor even though it asks an own-bar acceptance question
near-high minute closes may represent continuation or short-lived exhaustion, so the predictive direction must be frozen and tested rather than inferred after returns
using open, transaction VWAP, volume, amount, adjacent ranges, path endpoints, subwindows, market residuals, or a terminal factor would change the mechanism

rejected_concepts.reason: Volatility resolution, amount center of mass, late participation, range entropy, and other time-allocation mechanisms are terminal; changing their partitions or weights would be a prohibited variant.
Adding lags, beta, residuals, or market activity would repair or extend terminal Campaign021 rather than create an independent Campaign022 family.
Bin edges, top-half thresholds, and concentration transforms add unnecessary search freedom before the simpler continuous own-bar location question is tested.
Combining or transforming Campaign001-Campaign021 terminal definitions is prohibited.
